newsitem.title: USA: May crop report to include 97/98 projections - USDA.
newsitem.headline: May crop report to include 97/98 projections - USDA.

text.p: The Agriculture Department said Thursday its next monthly world agricultural report will include first assessments of supply, demand and prices for crops and livestock in the coming year.

The May 12 report, issued by USDA's World Agricultural Outlook Board, will also include the first projections for 1997/98 U.S. sugar and U.S. milk supply, and calendar year 1998 U.S. meat and poultry products.
Country supply and use details for 1997/98 will be included in the May report for wheat, coarse grains and corn.

The May report will also include minor changes in countries listed in the world oilseed and cotton tables, the USDA said. China will be added as a major importer of soybeans and soybean meal, India will be added as a major soybean meal exporter, and Indonesia will be added and Japan dropped in the category of major cotton importing countries.
